blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Police authorities arrested two men with unlicensed pistols and prohibited drugs in separate operations in Midsayap town, Cotabato and General Santos City on Friday, Nov. 27. Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, director of Police Regional Office (PRO-12), said police were conducting checkpoint operation around 1:30 a.m. when a motorist tried to evade them.
